_comment: April Fools' Day collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed april-fools-prank` (lines may be shared with other collections since #24), then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_fools.py.

readme.title: April Fools' Day
looks: each line wears one prank: a harlequin jester motley (Tapu Lele, Plusle, Capsakid); clown white with big polka dots and a red nose (Vanillite, Tandemaus, Carvanha); covered in googly eyes that roll around (Geodude, Rhyhorn, Cryogonal); 'wrong colours', every colour swapped round the wheel (Paras, Aerodactyl, Cobalion); pixelated into chunky blocks, as if it never loaded (Archen, Varoom, Yungoos); showered with confetti and streamers that twinkle (Stunky, Finneon, Sizzlipede)
the confetti twinkles and the googly eyes look around in the dark
shiny: the prank colours turned round the colour wheel
